parameters.name: App
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the stream belongs, and it cannot be modified.

parameters.name: EncryptParameters
parameters.description:
The encryption configuration. The value is a JSON string. The following fields are included in the syntax:

*   EncryptType: the type of the encryption. Set the value to **aliyun**.
*   KmsKeyID: the ID of the CMK in KMS.
*   KmsKeyExpireInterval: the validity period of the CMK. Valid values: **60 to 3600**. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Lazy
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable triggered transcoding. Valid values:

*   **yes**: enables triggered transcoding.
*   **no**: disables triggered transcoding.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live update-live-stream-transcode --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain example.com --app liveApp0000 --template lsd --encrypt-parameters EncryptType_:_aliyun_,_KmsKeyID_:_afce5722-81d2-43c3-9930-7601da110000_,_KmsKeyExpireInterval_:_3600 --lazy yes --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live UpdateLiveStreamTranscode --region cn-hangzhou --App liveApp0000 --Lazy yes --EncryptParameters 'EncryptType_:_aliyun_,_KmsKeyID_:_afce5722-81d2-43c3-9930-7601da110000_,_KmsKeyExpireInterval_:_3600' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Domain 'example.com' --Template lsd
